source: Survey of the window-system sources, 2026-11-03 (src/egl/drivers/dri2/platform_x11.c, src/loader)

cases.criteria: A 256x256 window surface, a clear and eglSwapBuffers give that colour through XGetImage
A 64x64 pbuffer clear reads back with glReadPixels
Under modesetting without glamor (no DRI3) eglInitialize fails; no llvmpipe display
Before a dEQP shard the libEGL, libGLESv2 and libGL links resolve into the run dir and dEQP-GLES2.info.renderer logs poulsback
Every dEQP shard records the config it picked; a run on any config other than rgba8888d24s8ms0 is flagged, so stencil NotSupported never looks clean
